blocks.section: Methods for sealing the shaft
Methods for sealing the shaft
blocks.content: These sections discuss the methods that you can use to seal the shaft.

blocks.section: Methods for sealing the shaft
blocks.content: Seal the shaft with a dynamic seal.

blocks.section: Methods for sealing the shaft
blocks.content: Seal the shaft with a cartridge-mechanical seal.

blocks.section: Methods for sealing the shaft
blocks.content: Seal the shaft with a conventional inside-component mechanical seal.

blocks.section: Methods for sealing the shaft
blocks.content: Seal the shaft with a conventional outside-component mechanical seal.

blocks.section: Methods for sealing the shaft
blocks.content: Seal the shaft with a packed stuffing box.

blocks.section: Seal the shaft with a dynamic seal
blocks.content: Seal the shaft with a dynamic seal

blocks.section: Seal the shaft with a dynamic seal
blocks.content: Place the backplate (444) with the flat side down on the bench.

blocks.section: Seal the shaft with a dynamic seal
blocks.content: Place the repeller (262) in the backplate (444) with the sleeve side up.

blocks.section: Seal the shaft with a dynamic seal
blocks.content: Place a Teflon gasket (264) on the backplate (444) and align the holes in the gasket with the holes in the backplate.

blocks.section: Seal the shaft with a dynamic seal
blocks.content: Place a stuffing-box cover (184) on the backplate (444) and align the holes in the gasket with the holes in the backplate.

blocks.section: Seal the shaft with a dynamic seal
blocks.content: Install four socket-head capscrews (265) and tighten them securely.

blocks.section: Seal the shaft with a dynamic seal
blocks.content: Install a new sealing element into the gland.

blocks.section: Seal the shaft with a dynamic seal
blocks.content: Install a gasket (360Q) and gland (107) on the stuffing-box cover (184).

blocks.section: Seal the shaft with a dynamic seal
Seal the shaft with a dynamic seal
blocks.content: Install a dynamic-seal assembly and nuts (370H).

blocks.section: Seal the shaft with a dynamic seal
blocks.content: Check the stuffing-box-cover runout and rotate the indicator through 360 degrees. An indicator reading that is greater than 0.005 in. (0.013 mm) indicates a problem.
